question: Are the two direction-v50 gate entry points deterministic and CI-trustworthy across repeated invocations - i.e. does the one unexplained exit-1 of accepted record section 11 survive as a measurable non-zero rate, or is the pair byte-stable - and can that rate be measured by a harness that is itself proven non-vacuous?
hypothesis: H-REPEAT-INVARIANCE. The accepted served-lineage invocation (run_bar_gates) and the accepted lineage sweep invocation (run_label_lineage_gate) are pure functions of pinned bytes: identical normalized records and exit 0 on every repetition, so the section-11 exit-1 does not reproduce at a measurable rate and the accepted 'cannot produce 1 by construction' statement holds operationally. The harness that measures this is itself falsifiable: it must classify a deliberately broken invocation (exit 2) as a detected non-zero, otherwise a 0-non-zero rate would be vacuous. Separately, the mechanism class of an unexplained exit-1 is reachable through a realistic CI invocation that closes stdout early (pipe to head/jq), because both entry points emit their entire JSON payload as a single write at the end of main(); this probe is recorded independently and can never change the invariance verdict.

product_decision_unlocked: If P1-P6 hold, the lane can tell Product and the control plane that the two direction-v50 gates are safe to wire into CI as exit-code gates: repeated invocation of the accepted entry points is byte-stable, a non-zero exit is a real signal rather than flakiness, and the harness that claims this is itself proven able to see a non-zero. If P3 is falsified, the gates are NOT safe to treat as deterministic and that bounded negative goes to the control plane instead.
claim_ceiling_if_it_passes: At most: over 20 measured invocations of the two accepted direction-v50 entry points on pinned bytes, every exit code was 0 and every normalized record was byte-identical, so no run-to-run nondeterminism was observed at N=10 per entry point (0/10 is bounded by a rule-of-three 95% upper bound of 0.30, not zero); the measuring harness demonstrably detects a deliberately broken invocation; and one realistic invocation class (stdout closed early) deterministically reaches a non-zero exit with a captured signature. It says NOTHING about whether the two absolute bars are met, about label soundness, geometry soundness, retrieval or counter-authority recall, the served packet's admissibility, whether Product should rebuild the packet, or whether the map helps a jurist. human_gate_ready stays false.
